bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/restore-completed-features-20261115"
compose="$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
image=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-completed-f19f4f5
backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-rollback-20261115
test -f "$compose" || exit 67
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
old="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")"
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-final-1cae702)" || exit 74
test "$old" = "$expected" || { echo ACTIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree)" = true || exit 74
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin fix/restore-search-profile-room-preserve-menu-20261115
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = f19f4f58f195db8ff0886bad18f35bdb163bd694 || exit 74
if test -d "$work";then
 test -z "$(git -C "$work" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76
 test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = f19f4f58f195db8ff0886bad18f35bdb163bd694 || exit 74
else
 git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$work" f19f4f58f195db8ff0886bad18f35bdb163bd694
fi
log="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host -f "$work/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "$image" "$work" >"$log" 2>&1;then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$log";then exit 51;fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$log";then exit 52;fi
 if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|TLS handshake' "$log";then exit 53;fi
 exit 55
fi
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$image" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 81
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$image")"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image tag "$old" "$backup"
cat > "$work/restore-override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-completed-f19f4f5
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$work/restore-rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-rollback-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/restore-override.yaml" config --quiet || exit 69
changed=0
recover(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;if test "$changed" = 1;then docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/restore-rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo RESTORE_ROLLBACK=PASS || echo RESTORE_ROLLBACK=FAIL;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap recover ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/restore-override.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$newid" || false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || false
trap - ERR
echo RESTORE_COMPLETED_FEATURES=PASS
echo DEPLOYED_SOURCE=f19f4f58f195db8ff0886bad18f35bdb163bd694
echo SEARCH_PROFILE_ROOM_BASE=5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo RESTORE_IMAGE_MATCH=PASS
